arguments.sql:
WITH italian_customers AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id
    FROM main.customers AS c
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN italian_customers AS c ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
    WHERE s.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND s.time_id < '2022-01-01'
),
cost_keys AS (
    SELECT prod_id, time_id, channel_id, promo_id, COUNT(*) AS cost_rows
    FROM main.costs
    WHERE time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND time_id < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY prod_id, time_id, channel_id, promo_id
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM italian_customers) AS registered_customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id) AS purchasing_customers,
       COUNT(*) AS sale_rows,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN k.cost_rows IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS rows_without_cost,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN k.cost_rows > 1 THEN 1 END) AS rows_with_multiple_costs,
       MIN(s.time_id) AS first_sale,
       MAX(s.time_id) AS last_sale
FROM monthly_sales AS s
LEFT JOIN cost_keys AS k
    ON k.prod_id = s.prod_id
   AND k.time_id = s.time_id
   AND k.channel_id = s.channel_id
   AND k.promo_id = s.promo_id

WITH RECURSIVE buckets(bucket) AS (
    VALUES (1)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bucket + 1
    FROM buckets
    WHERE bucket < 10
),
italian_customers AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id
    FROM main.customers AS c
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
),
purchase_profits AS (
    SELECT s.cust_id,
           SUM(s.quantity_sold * (k.unit_price - k.unit_cost)) AS total_profit
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN italian_customers AS c ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.costs AS k
        ON k.prod_id = s.prod_id
       AND k.time_id = s.time_id
       AND k.channel_id = s.channel_id
       AND k.promo_id = s.promo_id
    WHERE s.time_id >= '2021-12-01'
      AND s.time_id < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY s.cust_id
),
customer_profits AS (
    SELECT c.cust_id, COALESCE(p.total_profit, 0.0) AS total_profit
    FROM italian_customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN purchase_profits AS p ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
),
profit_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) AS min_profit, MAX(total_profit) AS max_profit
    FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed_profits AS (
    SELECT p.cust_id,
           p.total_profit,
           CASE
               WHEN r.min_profit = r.max_profit THEN 1
               ELSE MIN(10, 1 + CAST(
                   10.0 * (p.total_profit - r.min_profit)
                   / (r.max_profit - r.min_profit) AS INTEGER
               ))
           END AS bucket
    FROM customer_profits AS p
    CROSS JOIN profit_range AS r
)
SELECT b.bucket,
       COUNT(p.cust_id) AS customer_count,
       MIN(p.total_profit) AS min_total_profit,
       MAX(p.total_profit) AS max_total_profit
FROM buckets AS b
LEFT JOIN bucketed_profits AS p ON p.bucket = b.bucket
GROUP BY b.bucket
ORDER BY b.bucket
LIMIT 10
